manufacturer_update.manufacturer: Unknown; most likely Henkel (TECHNOMELT AS 838x) or Bostik (Thermogrip H94xx) polyolefin/APAO hot melt
manufacturer_update.product_identified: Non-reactive polyolefin hot-melt for attaching headliner/trim panel to roof (bulk box for bulk melter)
manufacturer_update.evidence: 408 kg = 900 lb exactly (like 271 kg drum ~ 600 lb), i.e. a US-unit bulk hot-melt box/tote typical for bulk melters; Henkel TECHNOMELT AS 8383 TDS explicitly lists headliner attachment; Bostik Thermogrip H9446/H9438/9431 TDSs list headliner attachment. Reactive PUR (TECHNOMELT PUR 9622-02) / water-based (TEROSON PU A235 W) are headliner LAMINATION adhesives used at the headliner supplier, less likely for a final-assembly 'HDLNG T/PNL' item.
